name: Abiathar
summary: A priest, the son of Ahimelech, who alone escaped when Saul had the priests of Nob killed. He stayed with David for many years, but Solomon sent him away after he sided with Adonijah.

key_moments.title: Escape from Nob
key_moments.description: Doeg killed the priests of Nob at Saul's command, but Abiathar escaped and fled to David. David told him to stay with him and he would be safe.

key_moments.title: Brings the Ephod to David
key_moments.description: Abiathar brought the ephod to David at Keilah. Through it David asked the LORD whether Saul would come and whether the men of Keilah would hand him over.

key_moments.title: Carrying the Ark Back
key_moments.description: As David left the city, Zadok came with the ark of God and Abiathar went up too. David sent the ark back, and Zadok and Abiathar carried it again to Jerusalem.

key_moments.title: Sent Home to Anathoth
key_moments.description: Solomon said Abiathar deserved death, but spared him because he had carried the ark before David and shared his troubles. He sent Abiathar to his own fields at Anathoth and put him out of the priesthood.
